title: 美银乔虹：PMI掩盖了需求侧真相
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: Well, to be honest, the PMI doesn't really tell the story.
segments.zh: 老实说，PMI并不能说明全部问题。

segments.en: We have to wait until two weeks later when we look at the third quarter data together with the June Activity Growth Indicators.
segments.zh: 我们必须等到两周后，结合6月活动增长指标来看三季度数据。

segments.en: At the moment, I think PMI tells us that on the supply side, things are okay, but we already know that. Think about exports, think about IP. They have been pretty resilient for some time.
segments.zh: 目前PMI告诉我们供给端尚可，但这已是已知信息。出口和工业产出已持续韧性一段时间。

segments.en: So the question is really on the demand side, consumption and investment, as I've just said.
segments.zh: 所以问题真正在于需求侧，即消费和资本开支。

segments.en: And so what are we tracking here in terms of this K-shaped? I mean, it seems like out of all the economy we talk about, you're seeing it much more wider, this K of an economy, is the macro story that we're seeing around Asia?
segments.zh: 那么我们在K型复苏方面追踪什么？似乎在我们讨论的所有经济体中，这种K型分化更为广泛，这是亚洲的宏观故事吗？
